F1 Not supported Risk rank elevated in the 60 min before empirical abnormal-period onsets vs month-matched ordinary running (PRIMARY ENDPOINT)Evidence: PE +0.051 rank units, 95% CI [-0.087, +0.119], NC2 p 0.1184, Cliff's delta +0.21, n 10/12

F2 Weak Rank elevation at horizons beyond 1 h (2-24 h windows; WEAK uses raw p < 0.10, SUPPORTED needs BH q < 0.05)Evidence: 120 min WEAK (p 0.024, q 0.096, n 8; censored PE +0.089 vs uncensored +0.018); 240 min WEAK (p 0.011, q 0.088, n 8; censored PE +0.095 vs uncensored +0.022); 360 min WEAK (p 0.036, q 0.097, n 8; censored PE +0.085 vs uncensored -0.002); 720 min NOT_SUPPORTED (p 0.235, q 0.268, n 8; censored PE +0.096 vs uncensored -0.040); 1440 min NOT_SUPPORTED (p 0.103, q 0.190, n 7; censored PE +0.092 vs uncensored -0.062); about 0.5 of 5 horizons are expected below raw p 0.10 under the null; the excess is consistent with within-shift persistence of censored onsets

F3 Not supported Five historical warning-rule definitions were each tested against the abnormal periods5 rule definitions, each not supported. Details are withheld under Phase 8 section 26. None of the rules is a live flag.

F4 Weak Direction of the point estimate consistent across June / July / August (each month too small to test)Evidence: JUN PE +0.092 (n 3); JUL PE +0.051 (n 4); AUG PE +0.031 (n 3); leave-one-month-out: without JUN +0.034 p 0.253; without JUL +0.057 p 0.118; without AUG +0.068 p 0.194 (per-month n < 6: month-level SUPPORTED impossible by design)Context only: not evidence of an effect.

F5 Weak 60-min pre-onset rank elevation with the kiln-inlet O2 analyser (Kiln-I!X) excluded (primary decision rule applied to the O2-excluded VALIDATION_VARIANT; SENSITIVE_TO_O2)Evidence: like-for-like (the primary's 10 periods): PE +0.088 vs primary +0.051 (difference +0.037), p 0.0625 - same direction, not significant at 0.05; own event set (post-result amendment): PE +0.088, CI [-0.057, +0.147], p 0.0455, n 12; a second test of the same hypothesis, not multiplicity-adjusted

F6 Insufficient data Primary result survives load adjustment / matching / transition exclusionEvidence: load verdict INSUFFICIENT_DATA: LOAD_ADJUSTED +0.043 (p 0.145, n 10), MATCHED_LOAD +0.035 (p 0.083, n 9), TRANSITION_EXCLUDED +0.069 (p 0.147, n 5), LOW_FEED_EXCLUDED +0.073 (p 0.048, n 6)

F7 Not supported Effect distinguishable from circular-shift (NC1) and random-onset (NC2) nullsEvidence: NC1 p 0.1916 (null median -0.012); NC2 p 0.1184 (null median -0.002)

F8 Supported Sign of the primary point estimate not driven by a single abnormal period (leave-one-event-out; sign stability only, not significance)Evidence: LOEO PE range [+0.034, +0.068] over 10 fits; primary endpoint itself NOT_SUPPORTEDContext only: not evidence of an effect.

F9 Not supported Risk score carries pre-onset information beyond the Phase 3 KPI itself (KPI persistence)Evidence: Cliff's delta risk +0.21 vs KPI +0.17 (KPI PE +0.044, p 0.1319); no formal test of the difference (n = 12)

F10 Not supported Pre-onset rank elevation relative to the preceding 7 days (reference-free rolling rank; checks for a Phase 7 reference artefact, not independent of the KPI onset)Evidence: rolling-rank PE +0.345, CI [-0.048, +0.439], p 0.0250; control median rolling rank 0.40 (0.50 expected for neutral controls; the controls are selected low-KPI time, so the comparison is biased and cannot support the claim); a rise relative to the preceding week is also what a KPI CUSUM onset implies

F11 Not supported Pre-onset association at least as strong as the post-period (backward) associationEvidence: pre-onset PE +0.051 vs post-end PE +0.099 (trailing-window persistence expected)

F12 Not supported 'Lead' before Phase 6 detection (KPI >= P90) as independent evidenceEvidence: detection-anchored PE +0.163: mechanical - the KPI is a 6-h median of the same components

F13 Not supported Phase 4 indicator Kiln-I!I|ROC_1H adds pre-onset informationEvidence: active at T0 in 0.40 of periods vs 0.43 of controls, p 0.696

F14 Blocked A deployable early-warning alert thresholdEvidence: thresholds were frozen from independent populations and evaluated, but an alert threshold needs event ground truth (costs of missed / unnecessary alerts); month-holdout and LOEO results are validation diagnostics only

F15 Blocked Deposit / ring / coating / failure / maintenance early warningEvidence: no plant event ground truth in the supplied data (Phase 1 EVENT GROUND TRUTH NOT FOUND)

F16 Blocked Lead time to plant eventsEvidence: no plant event timestamps

F17 Blocked Origin of the ambient-like kiln-inlet O2 readingsEvidence: ANALYSER_BEHAVIOUR_REQUIRES_PLANT_CONFIRMATION (purge / calibration behaviour of Kiln-I!X)

F18 Insufficient data Pre-onset rank elevation present among uncensored onsets (the shift had not begun before the 6-h look-back)Evidence: uncensored onsets only: PE -0.072 (negative direction), p 0.8011, n 5 (all evaluable: PE +0.051, n 10); censored-only PE +0.082. A censored T0 is the look-back cap, so its window lies inside the KPI shift; an uncensored T0 is the CUSUM zero, a local low - the 60-min endpoint cannot measure precedence for either group

F19 Not supported 60-min pre-onset rank elevation with the event data-quality rule (POOR share, stop / transition) applied to control windows tooEvidence: PE +0.057, CI [-0.073, +0.124], p 0.1074, n 10, 5971 controls, control median 0.825 (primary 0.833)

F20 Not supported 60-min pre-onset rank elevation with controls that exclude only the 12 final periods (not the other KPI >= P90 candidates)Evidence: PE +0.051, CI [-0.087, +0.121], p 0.1314, n 10, 6938 controls, control median 0.832 (primary 0.833)

DALMIA CEMENT|Kiln Analytical POC

Ariyalur kiln · Jun–Aug 2025 · historical

Retrospective, not an early warning. Historical analysis of Jun–Aug 2025 only. It does not show live data, raise alarms or detect deposits, rings or coating.

Retrospective, not an early warning. Historical analysis of Jun–Aug 2025 only. It does not show live data, raise alarms or detect deposits, rings or coating.

Censored onsets

6 of 12 onsets are censored. Served meaning: a censored onset is the look-back cap, so its window lies inside the KPI shift; the CENSORED slices are not evidence of precedence (Phase 8 F18); the UNCENSORED slices show no pre-onset excess.

Findings

Each finding keeps its own Phase 8 class. Classes are not added up or scored.

What the evidence shows

How to read this

Many onsets are censored6 of 12 onsets are censored by the look-back cap: a censored onset is the look-back cap, so its window lies inside the KPI shift; the CENSORED slices are not evidence of precedence (Phase 8 F18); the UNCENSORED slices show no pre-onset excess.Source: Phase 8 censoring

Many onsets are censored

6 of 12 onsets are censored by the look-back cap: a censored onset is the look-back cap, so its window lies inside the KPI shift; the CENSORED slices are not evidence of precedence (Phase 8 F18); the UNCENSORED slices show no pre-onset excess.

The O₂ analyser may be reading ambient airFrequent ambient-air-like kiln-inlet O2 readings; excluding the analyser roughly halves the Jun-Aug score rise and changes the Phase 8 primary result from NOT_SUPPORTED to WEAK. The purge / calibration behaviour needs plant confirmation.Source: L07

The O₂ analyser may be reading ambient air

Frequent ambient-air-like kiln-inlet O2 readings; excluding the analyser roughly halves the Jun-Aug score rise and changes the Phase 8 primary result from NOT_SUPPORTED to WEAK. The purge / calibration behaviour needs plant confirmation.

There is no plant ground truthNo coating, ring, deposit, cleaning, maintenance or stoppage-reason records exist in the supplied data. Detection, risk and early-warning claims cannot be validated against plant events.Source: L01

There is no plant ground truth

No coating, ring, deposit, cleaning, maintenance or stoppage-reason records exist in the supplied data. Detection, risk and early-warning claims cannot be validated against plant events.
